title: Moments After Beheading His Wife
description:
He was charged with m*rder, and his bond was initially set at $500,000 but was later increased to $1 million. During his pre-trial, potential mental health issues were raised regarding his competency to stand trial, but he was ultimately deemed competent. On July 31, 2024, Jared was sentenced to 40 years in prison after he pleaded guilty to the crime. He will not be eligible for parole until 2043.

for DWI, during which he threatened the officers and punched a window at the police department.
The sheriff's office had visited the property multiple times on reports of domestic violence.
He was charged with murder, and his bond was initially set at $500,000, but was later increased
to $1 million. During his pre-trial, potential mental health issues were raised regarding his
competency to stand trial, but he was ultimately deemed competent. On July 31st, 2024,
Jared was sentenced to 40 years in prison after he pleaded guilty to the crime.
